description: This file contains utility functions for automated UI flow testing related to asset management pages in a web application, using Playwright for browser automation and testing. It provides functions to navigate to specific pages, perform actions like copying assets, and verify UI elements and confirmation dialogs.

methods.name: export async function gotoAssetsList(page: Page): Promise<void> { gotoAssetsList
methods.description: Navigates to the Assets list page and asserts that the page loaded by checking for the presence of an assets heading.

methods.name: export async function gotoAssetDetails(page: Page, assetId: string): Promise<void> { gotoAssetDetails
methods.description: Navigates to a specific Asset Details page using an asset ID and asserts that some heading is visible to confirm the page loaded.

methods.name: export async function gotoCopyAssetPage(page: Page, assetId: string): Promise<void> { gotoCopyAssetPage
methods.description: Navigates to the copy asset page for a specific asset ID and asserts that the 'New Asset Name' input is visible.

methods.description: Fills in the new asset name, clicks the continue button, and asserts that a 'Confirmation!' modal appears.

methods.name: export async function assertCopyConfirmationShowsFields(page: Page, fields: { assetName: string;/ assertCopyConfirmationShowsFields
methods.description: Verifies the visibility of Asset Name, Permit EU ID, and Status Date in the confirmation dialog.

methods.name: export async function confirmCopy(page: Page): Promise<void> { confirmCopy
methods.description: Clicks the confirm and copy button in the confirmation dialog.

methods.description: Clicks the edit button to cancel the copy confirmation and asserts the form is visible again.
